newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Council sees need for car industry changes.
newsitem.headline: Council sees need for car industry changes.

text.p: European Union industry ministers, describing the automobile industry as a key industrial sector, on Thursday said further structural changes were needed in the sector.
The ministers also said in Council conclusions on the sector that the industry itself had the primary responsibility for its competitiveness.

The text said the Council "acknowledges the improved performance of the industry in terms of competitiveness against the background of a European market that has not fully recovered from the 1993 fall in demand."

They considered nonetheless that "the structural adjustment of the industry which has taken place over the last five years must be pursued further during the rest of the decade and beyond, in order to ensure the industry's international competitiveness and its further expansion into world markets."
But public authorities had the responsibility to contribute to a favourable business environment for the industry, the ministers said.
They invited the Commission, member states and industry to take action to promote intangible investments, ensure strong and fair competition and develop industrial cooperation.

The agreement on cars with Japan, which provides for the progressive opening of the EU market, should continue to apply and access and investment opportunities for car makers nd equipment suppliers on third markets, notably South Korea and Japan, should be improved.
